description.en: Pareiasaurus serridens inspired living reconstruction: whole living environment prop. Nominal 1m TECHNICAL art scale, not biological measurement. AMNH1913 complete skeletal illustration supplies whole silhouette, not a single accession. Cisneros2005 distinguishes Pareiasaurus serridens from Provelosaurus and names independent comparison specimens BMNH R4063 and TM1474; not the illustrated skeleton. Romano2021 genus-specific separated osteoderms across body; no Scutosaurus geometry reuse. Blunt broad cheek-flanged head, deep barrel, four stout limbs and short complete tail. Low irregular isolated armor not fused shell. Exact colors, tissue, pose, toes, scute layout artistic. No copied mesh or textures.
